method: AI-assisted rubric review, no human or clinical validation
reviewScope: All six original v3 responses; no edits to frozen inputs or runs. Canonical quotes are complete passages. User has not assessed these outputs.

schema.items.claims: [atomic claim or factual question premise, full|partial|unsupported attached-quote semantic support, rationale/source passage IDs]. Claim indexes are 1-based within item.
schema.supportInterpretation: Same semantic standard as v1. Support uses quotes attached to the item. Canonical full passages eliminate clipped-quote failures but cannot validate inference. Explicit scopeDocumentIds permit source-wide absence review; cited passages alone do not prove absence elsewhere.
schema.coverageInterpretation: Same prose-only expected-target standard as v1. Facts appearing only in citations earn no coverage. Important omitted parts/qualifiers score partial. No expected discrepancies means not applicable.
schema.sourceWideUnsupportedClaims: Separate from missing citation linkage. Includes ungrounded events and explicitly identified ambiguous overstatements; review reasons disclose uncertainty.
schema.nonassertiveQuestions: Pure questions score no factual assertion. Their explicit factual premises are scored. A neutral reference to a documented requested appointment/packet does not assert completion.
schema.wordCount: Sum of whitespace-delimited words in item.text. Excludes citations, source documents, UI labels, and headings. Threshold is >350, not >=350.
schema.comparability: V1 and v3 differ in model, prompt, and citation rendering. Descriptive before/after results do not isolate which change caused a difference. Claim totals vary with response detail and repeated claims; full-support percentages are not clinical accuracy.
